chunks: And from him, from Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar ibn Wahb, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, who said:
I was present with Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام when his son Muḥammad passed away. Then he said to al-Ḥasan: “O my son, renew gratitude to Allah, for He has brought about in you a matter.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan, the Imam referred to in the report
key_terms.أَمْرًا: a matter or affair of significance established by Allah
key_terms.تُوُفِّيَ: passed away; was taken in death
key_terms.شُكْرًا: gratitude or thanks directed to Allah
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٌ: Muḥammad, the deceased son mentioned in the narration
key_terms.يَا بُنَيَّ: O my son; an affectionate direct address

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the succession of al-Ḥasan عليه السلام after the death of Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report describes a moment after the death of Muḥammad, the son of Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, when the Imam addresses al-Ḥasan عليه السلام with words of gratitude to Allah. In Shia context, the statement points to a significant divine matter being established in al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, and thus serves as part of the narrations connected to the designation of the succeeding Imam.

en.hubeali: And from him, from Musa Bin Ja’far Bin Wahab, from Ali Bin Ja’far Who said,

‘I was presence with Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup> when his<sup>asws</sup> son Muhammad died. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! Renew the thanks to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for the command (Imamate) has come to be in you<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. From him who has narrated from Musa ibn Ja‘far ibn Wahab from Ali ibn Ja‘far who has said the following.

“I was present with abu al-Hassan (a.s.) when his son Muhammad died. The Imam (a.s.) said this to (his son) al-Hassan (a.s.), “Son renew your thanks to Allah because He has just granted you the matter (Leadership with Divine Authority).”
